answer: The vine test I would run is Signed croquet club membership with croquet association attestation: a membership the croquet association lists on its roll, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so a membership the croquet association lists on its roll stays private; the lantern is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the garden of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
